author: Devika Rao — SAP Inventory Data Engineer
note: Status values: PRESENT | MISSING | UNCONFIRMED | RESOLVED | NOT_APPLICABLE. S-2 updated statuses and added pipeline-layer findings.

gaps.impact: HIGH — without this flag, Critical Spares page cannot distinguish critical vs non-critical materials
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm exact SAP field name or classification characteristic used by Vedanta to mark critical spares
gaps.fallback: Allow manual upload of critical-spares list (CSV: MATNR, WERKS, CRITICAL=Y/N) until SAP field confirmed
gaps.s2_note: Pipeline reads CRITICAL_FLAG column from stock_master extract. If absent, all materials default to critical_flag=False and a G-01 gap entry is written to the drop log. Downstream code renders 'Data not available' for Critical Spares Availability.

gaps.impact: HIGH — Fill Rate cannot be calculated without reservation data
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm RESB is included in GCS export; confirm KZEAR semantics for Vedanta's PM process
gaps.fallback: Show 'Data not available — RESB export pending' on Inventory Health page
gaps.s2_note: compute_fill_rate() returns None with gap 'G-02' when blocked=True. The API passes blocked=True until RESB data is confirmed present. No wrong number is shown.

gaps.impact: MEDIUM — without snapshots, turnover uses point-in-time stock (less accurate)
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm whether GCS export includes historical MARD snapshots or only current stock
gaps.fallback: Use current MARD.LABST as both start and end of period (point-in-time approximation; flag on dashboard)
gaps.s2_note: compute_inv_turnover() accepts g03_point_in_time=True flag. When set, a G-03 gap entry is appended to the metric's gap list and the dashboard renders a footnote. The number is still shown but labelled as approximate.

gaps.impact: MEDIUM — Critical Spares page cannot show next shutdown date without this
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm PM order types used for planned shutdowns at Vedanta plants; confirm GCS export path
gaps.fallback: Show 'Shutdown calendar not available' on Critical Spares page
gaps.s2_note: transform_maintenance_calendar() derives shutdown_flag from order type (PM03 → True) when SHUTDOWN_FLAG column is absent, and logs a G-04 gap entry. Downstream pages show 'Shutdown calendar not available' when the maintenance_calendar table is empty.

gaps.required_field: ContextFlow MCP endpoint, API key, input/output schema
gaps.impact: HIGH — Demand Forecast page and Stock Actions page depend on ContextFlow output
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm ContextFlow MCP connection details, rate limits, and expected output schema
gaps.fallback: Show 'Forecast not available — ContextFlow connection pending' on Demand Forecast and Stock Actions pages

gaps.required_field: ContextFlow historical forecast_qty for past periods
gaps.impact: MEDIUM — Forecast Quality page requires at least one prior forecast period to compute MAPE/Bias
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm whether ContextFlow stores historical forecast outputs or only produces forward forecasts
gaps.fallback: Show 'Insufficient forecast history — MAPE/Bias available after first full forecast cycle'

gaps.impact: CRITICAL — no real data can be loaded until actual GCS path is confirmed
gaps.resolution_needed: Replace placeholder gs://bucket/path with real bucket name and folder structure in GCS_BUCKET_PATH env var
gaps.fallback: None — pipeline cannot run without this
gaps.s2_note: GCS_BUCKET_PATH is read from environment (pipeline/config.py). The extractor raises DataSourceUnavailableError when the path is the placeholder value. The API returns HTTP 503 with a clear message. No wrong number is shown. Action required: set GCS_BUCKET_PATH in .env before first live run.

gaps.required_field: SAP movement type list — exact BWART codes used by Vedanta for consumption
gaps.impact: HIGH — wrong movement types will corrupt all consumption-based metrics
gaps.resolution_needed: Vedanta SAP team to confirm which BWART codes represent actual consumption (not transfers, returns, etc.)
gaps.fallback: Use standard list (201, 261, 551, 601) with note on dashboard; update CONSUMPTION_BWART_LIST in config.py once confirmed
gaps.s2_note: CONSUMPTION_BWART_LIST is configurable in pipeline/config.py and overridable via CONSUMPTION_BWART_LIST env var (comma-separated). Current default: [201, 261, 551, 601]. Every row dropped by this filter is counted in the drop log and reconciliation report. Rows dropped: shown in Data & Methodology page.

gaps.metric: Inventory Value, Safety Stock, Reorder Point
gaps.required_field: MBEW.VERPR (moving average price) — may be zero for non-valuated materials
gaps.impact: MEDIUM — zero or missing price will show INR 0 inventory value for affected materials
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm valuation method (MAP vs standard price) per material type at Vedanta
gaps.fallback: Cascade: VERPR → STPRS → LAEPR → 0 with 'Price missing' flag
gaps.s2_note: Price cascade implemented in transform_stock_master(). Materials with price_missing=True are counted in the drop log (rows_flagged, not rows_dropped — they are retained). compute_inv_value() appends a G-09 gap entry for these materials. Dashboard renders 'Price missing — value shown as 0' tooltip.

gaps.impact: LOW — filter will show plant codes instead of names
gaps.resolution_needed: Confirm T001W is included in GCS export
gaps.fallback: Display raw WERKS code in filter
gaps.s2_note: Pipeline reads plant codes from WERKS. If T001W is not in the GCS export, plant names default to the WERKS code. No metric is affected.
